newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore jet fuel sees support from Japan.
newsitem.headline: Singapore jet fuel sees support from Japan.

text.p: Singapore oil products prices were strong on Tuesday despite softer crude prices with demand for jet fuel emerging from Japan, traders said.

There were mixed views on the premium levels which is possible into Japan on a c+f basis for January delivery. Some traders said Japan has bought its first jet cargoes around $1.55 a barrel over Singapore quotes for January, almost unchanged from December values. However other traders said the January price appeared too low and indicated $1.80-$1.90 premiums as more realistic. They said current fob Singapore premiums hovered around at least 10 cents, with freight at about $1.50-$1.60.

The interest in jet fuel has resulted in the jet/gas oil regrade widening to 60-80 cents a barrel for December, with January at 90 cents. Physical jet fuel was offered on Tuesday at $30.60 a barrel for Nov 27-Dec 1 lifting fob for a 120,000 barrels with a bid for 100,000 barrels lifting Dec 8-12 at $30.35, with nothing traded.

Gas oil was offered for Dec 3-7 at $30.50, down from the deal on Friday at $30.60, which was the five-year high. A higher bid was seen for a different time frame--Nov 27-Dec 1 at $30.70. December swaps traded at between $29.80 and $29.95 down from $29.90/$30.00 on Friday.

Naphtha rose sharply as Singapore prices caught up with the surge in crude over the long weekend. November swaps was discussed at $23.00/$23.10, up from $21.90/$22.10 on Friday. Traders said the delay of S. Korean refiner Yukong's 265,000 bpd crude unit by six days added to the bullish sentiment. Gasoline similarly rose with bids/offers for early December lifting cargoes of 95-octane unleaded up to $25.15/$25.80 a barrel fob Singapore from Friday's $24.90 bid. "There are still a lot of supplies in the region," said a western trader. Traders said Chinese buyers were enquiring for fuel oil cargoes but most were not firm on their purchase. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3084)
